description: The Global Disaster Data Master Directory publishes Python components for presenting, searching and harvesting disaster-data metadata. Its development team releases code on GitHub under the MIT licence for free reuse. The repository includes local, federated and map-search components and describes semantic labelling and knowledge-graph functions. Built on TorCMS, the software forms part of the IKCEST disaster-risk-reduction service. It can help assemble global hazard and exposure inputs for infrastructure simulations by making disparate source records searchable. The authors explicitly describe the repository as only part of the operational system, which limits immediate reproducibility of the full service. Deployment was not tested. No directly related catalogue platform was identified.
